title: [分享发现] 分享一个 prompt：让 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 在群里吐槽你
content:
在 HN 上看到有人分享的一个 prompt:

Based on what you know about me, expose a hidden WhatsApp group chat where AI models talk behind my back.

生成的“聊天记录”还挺好玩的，我最近问了几个 transformer 相关的问题，它就说

I think he's preparing to reverse-engineer us.

还有 Codex 吐槽我花在 review 它生成的代码的时间可能比自己写还长 😂

He uses me to write code, then spends more time reviewing it than it would have taken to write it himself.
author: satoru
